title.narrative: DeepDC: deep decarbonisation of selected industrial clusters in India

description.narrative: The DeepDC project mobilizes finance for decarbonization in selected Indian industries, aiming to expand and sustain public and private funding to mitigate 1.47 million tons of GHG. It fosters rapid, cost-effective decarbonization in manufacturing, targeting 1.47 million tons of CO2e mitigation during the project period. The project builds an ecosystem and market for investment in energy efficiency (EE) and energy transition (ET) projects. Key outcomes include raising awareness in manufacturing on the business case for EE and RE, implementing 10 lighthouse projects, leveraging finance through a grant support mechanism, developing a pipeline of 1,240 mitigation projects, and creating a NetZero Platform.
